entries.after: 2026-11-07 current balance settings registered without numeric changes
entries.reason: Introduce reproducible balance versioning for future measurements.
entries.expected_impact: No gameplay change. Future logs can be separated and compared by balance version and configuration hash.

entries.before: No position-dependent enemy attack, wall-impact brittle state, or non-stacking protection resonance
entries.after: Added swarm_amplifier, impact_brittle, and protection_resonator with initial JSON-tunable parameters and authored validation stages; live validation set the reachable brittle wall-impact threshold to 6
entries.reason: Make moving, separating, and banking enemies into walls meaningful alternatives to direct damage.
entries.expected_impact: More shots choose displacement and target order; actual impact must be judged with fixed-condition telemetry and human playtests.

entries.before: Board-control enemies were available in definitions and four validation-oriented stages, but the requested 6/8/10-enemy authored progression set was absent.
entries.after: Added six authored Normal stages: two difficulty-1 six-enemy introductions, two difficulty-2 eight-enemy applications, and two difficulty-3 ten-enemy combinations.
entries.reason: Introduce separating, wall-impact and protection-breaking decisions into the normal run without changing enemy abilities or the existing stage selector.
entries.expected_impact: Board-control decisions appear from early to late progress while legacy Normal, MidBoss and Boss stages remain eligible; clear rate and shot count require fixed-condition measurement.

entries.before: Several board-control stage enemies used edge-biased positions, including two normal enemies extending 0.4 units beyond the field and three stages with less than the requested pocket safety margin.
entries.after: Moved board-control stage enemies toward the table center, preserved wall-side X positions for impact-brittle enemies, and guaranteed more than 6.0 units of clearance beyond enemy and pocket radii across all stages.
entries.reason: Prevent enemy balls from appearing outside the playable surface or too close to pocket mouths while retaining each stage's board-control decision.
entries.expected_impact: Cleaner initial presentation and safer shot access; dense groups are slightly more central, while impact-brittle wall routes remain available.

entries.target: 通常プレイの進行度別ステージ候補と敵行動予算
entries.before: 難易度帯のみで抽選、敵行動予算5、候補0件時は全ステージへフォールバック
entries.after: 進行度別JSON候補、進行度1-6は予算4、進行度7以降は予算5、未解放フォールバック禁止
entries.reason: 11月8日の序盤32シード検証結果を通常プレイへ正式導入し、6体・8体・10体構成の出現開始を段階化するため
entries.expected_impact: 序盤の理不尽なHP消費を抑え、進行度9以降の敵数と能力の増加を滑らかにする。勝率への効果は11月12日の再計測で確認する

entries.before: 保存済み選択AscensionをMCPランにも適用し、HP・敵攻撃が通常検証条件から変化
entries.after: 選択Ascensionは人間の通常プレイだけに適用し、MCP・自動検証はAscension 0
entries.reason: プレイヤーAIやステージ調整と無関係なメタ進行差を同一シード比較から除外するため
entries.expected_impact: MCP比較の開始HPを基礎値50へ統一し、敵攻撃ボーナスを除去する。人間の通常プレイで選択したAscensionには影響しない

entries.before: Full-health Armor boss dies immediately when pocketed
entries.after: Armor pocket removes one Armor; Break pocket deals ceil(25 percent max HP); survivors return safely; effect once per shot
entries.reason: Prevent the one-shot boss pocket route found in 100 fixed-seed runs while preserving pocket tactics and Armor/Break chains
entries.expected_impact: Boss battles use Armor and Break; pocket finishers remain possible at low HP; ordinary enemy pocket rules unchanged
entries.actual_result: Isolated boss fights won in Standard7/Heavy5/Pierce8/Bounce7/Anchor15 shots; 44 boss shot comparisons and 6 ordinary regression cases passed. Opening Armor pocket and 15-HP Break pocket verified. Not a population balance measurement.

entries.before: Raw shield grant adds 0.8 times urgency in addition to safety
entries.after: Raw shield bonus zero; actual damage prevention valued once by safety
entries.reason: Separate defensive value from unused shield capacity and killing-shot rewards
entries.expected_impact: More situational Guard selection; unchanged Guard and boss rules; compare 100 paired runs with B0007

entries.target: Final boss with three escorts and shared intent rules
entries.before: Single Armor boss and reusable neutral break balls
entries.after: Initial 3 escorts, capped summons, consumable wreck impacts, telegraphed attacks and Break interruption
entries.reason: Make ball choice, aiming and chains central to final boss combat
entries.expected_impact: Compare 100 paired runs with B0008; Guard unchanged

entries.before: Pocket-return placement clustered three minions beside the core; opening Break 44/44
entries.after: Authored asymmetric initial positions (-32,-18),(32,-10),(-44,22) with safe local fallback; summon placement unchanged
entries.reason: Remove universal opening Break through initial placement and collision routes
entries.expected_impact: Opening Break depends on aim and build; preserve Armor2, two following Break shots, Guard and AI scoring
entries.actual_result: Matched 50 seed/build pairs, all pre-boss outcomes and entry HP/deck/relics identical. Opening Break 44/44 to 0/44, first Break all shot 2. Run wins 44/50 unchanged, boss damage 2.68 to 2.64, core kill shots 7.14 to 6.50, Guard share 18.2% to 37.1%. Preserved Armor2/Break2/Guard. Existing post-pocket-core cleanup issue exposed in 5 battles; reported separately.

entries.before: Pocket-destroyed core skipped escort retirement and required extra shots
entries.after: Shared encounter-cleared rule resolves removed core, retires escorts at shot end, and informs prediction and boss AI
entries.reason: End the battle on core defeat even when the core object has already been removed
entries.expected_impact: No extra shot or escort attack after core death; Armor2, Break2, Guard, initial layout and B0010 archive retained
entries.actual_result: Reproduced B0010 pocket-kill bug with 4 surviving escorts. Fixed 5 axes x normal-fire/boss-AI (10 pocket kills): all clear in the same shot, no enemy turn or stale-plan replay. 93 final live/prediction shots, 11 MCP contract tests and native rules tests passed. Armor2/Break2/Guard data and all 118 B0010 result files unchanged.

entries.before: Recovery resets the next intent to normal attack 2
entries.after: Recovery interrupts its own enemy phase and announces strong attack 4 for the following player shot
entries.reason: Give a visible response opportunity after Break without changing Armor2, Break2, Guard, formation or pocket rewards
entries.expected_impact: More meaningful post-Break defense and interruption; compare 50 matched seed/build pairs with B0011
entries.actual_result: 50 matched seed/build pairs, pre-boss and entry conditions identical. Boss wins 44/44 unchanged; run wins 44/50 unchanged. Mean boss HP damage 2.523 -> 3.045, core kill shots 6.500 -> 6.295, Guard 108/286 -> 110/277 (37.8% -> 39.7%). Strong attacks: Break interruptions 5 -> 0, executions 6 -> 30 (28 on Guard), kill cancellations 1 -> 4. All 44 prefixes through first recovery identical; no post-core extra shot, residual escort or damage. Native rules, Python32 tests and 95 live/prediction shots passed. No collection crash, retry or exclusion; 117 B0011 archive files unchanged. Only recovery intent changed; protected balance maintained.

entries.target: Prepaid minion supply before the last Break shot
entries.before: Only summon after strong attack; final Break shot has zero or one minion
entries.after: Before Break remaining 1 input, supply up to two living minions once per strong-attack cycle; skip prepaid later summon; no refund on re-Break
entries.reason: Provide material and a preparation shot for re-Break while preserving Armor2, Break2, Guard, initial formation, pocket rewards and AI scoring
entries.expected_impact: More feasible interruption routes; compare 50 matched runs with B0012
entries.actual_result: 50 matched seed/build pairs. Run wins 44/50 and boss wins 44/44 unchanged. Boss mean HP damage 3.045 -> 4.477; core kill shots 6.295 -> 6.159; Guard 110/277 -> 106/271 (39.7% -> 39.1%). Strong Break interruptions 0 -> 2, executions 30 -> 29, kill cancellations 4 -> 6. Both interruptions used Heavy on Standard/Anchor builds. 44 prepaid claims, 54 requested/spawned, 5 later summons skipped; no duplicate or wrong-timing supply. First-supply prefixes identical in 44 battles, post-core extras/residuals/damage zero. Native rules, Python36 tests, 100 scoped live/prediction shots passed. B0012 archive117 files unchanged; no collection crashes/retries/exclusions. Unrelated pre-existing Guard self-pocket prediction discrepancy documented separately and unchanged.
